headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2020, Omega & Page vs. Jurassic Express went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.82. It was the first title opportunity of Jurassic Express's career. It marked Omega & Page's 10th match with the title on the line. An edgy title defense ? the champions showed real ruthlessness against the fellow babyface challengers, with Jungle Boy putting up a strong early fight before Omega and Page closed it out with Last Call.

It was 2026 when Jon Moxley vs. Jack Perry met in a Continental Cup Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 8.02 ? an excellent showing. Moxley advanced to the Continental Challenge Cup quarterfinals, holding off a relentless Jack Perry in a hard-fought main event.
On this day in 2022, Tay Conti left that name behind for good, stepping out as Tay Melo after 19 matches under the old identity, on Rampage.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2023, Bronson competed under the AEW banner for the first time, appearing on Collision, rated 5.60.
On a Friday in 2022, back when Erick Redbeard arrived in AEW, appearing on Rampage, rated 4.66.

It was 2023 when House of Black vs. CMFTR fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Collision, rated 7.43 ? a solid showing. CMFTR was challenging for gold for the very first time.
